build_depth_subdivision: build a DepthSubdivision module that reparametrizes rays using uniform depth slices between near and far planes
build_radial_subdivision: build a RadialSubdivision module that intersects rays with concentric spheres at uniform radii between near and far
build_voxel_subdivision: build a VoxelSubdivision module that intersects rays with an octree voxel grid and reparametrizes into voxel-local coordinates
build_latent_voxel_subdivision: build a LatentVoxelSubdivision module that extends voxel subdivision with learnable latent embeddings per voxel
review_subdivision_dict: review the subdivision_dict registry mapping depth, radial, voxel, and latent_voxel keys to their Subdivision classes
